description: Keyboard loudness calibration. Each pass rewrites per-pitch hammer_mass (one undo group per pass) and runs for seconds to minutes.

commands.name: calibration.synthesis
commands.title: Calibrate synthesis (offline)
commands.description: Step 2: one-pass offline synthesis calibration, no microphone. Long-running: returns a jobId. velocity is MIDI 1-127 (0 is refused); pitches = list or 'all' (key pitches only).

target_rms.description: Target RMS; default = the saved reference

commands.name: calibration.acoustic
commands.title: Calibrate acoustically (microphone)
commands.description: Step 3: microphone-based acoustic calibration with precision awareness. Long-running: returns a jobId. Needs a selected microphone and a saved reference (or target_rms).

target_rms.description: Target RMS; default = the saved reference

commands.name: calibration.attack_equalize
commands.title: Equalize attack loudness (A-weighted)
commands.description: The Virtual Piano Calibrate button: equalizes every key's A-weighted ATTACK level (first 300 ms after the onset, energy-summed over the heard = unmuted output channels) to the reference key within tolerance_db, by per-key hammer_mass (clamped 0.1 g .. 1 kg), iterating up to max_passes. Offline renders in ONE calibration session (the realtime engine stops once). No output_scale change, no mass rescale. ONE undo group: the result's `group` (history.undo {group}). Long-running: returns a jobId; job.cancel stops it after the current render.

reference_pitch.description: The reference key (MIDI pitch; the Virtual Piano's selected key)

pitches.description: Keys to equalize: list or 'all' (key pitches only; the reference is never changed)

tolerance_db.description: Stop when every key is within this many dB of the reference

max_passes.description: Correction passes at most; 0 = measure only (no write)

channels.description: Output channels to measure; default = every unmuted channel

commands.name: calibration.status
commands.title: Calibration status
commands.description: Progress of the running calibration pass (running, progress 0-1, step, message, results).

commands.name: calibration.mic_devices
commands.title: Microphone inputs
commands.description: The mic capture input: devices, and on ASIO (asio true) the physical inputs [{index, name, supported}] with the selected input_channel (0 = In 1). Read only; the user chooses the input in Calibration Settings.

commands.name: calibration.cancel
commands.title: Cancel calibration
commands.description: Stops the running calibration after the current pitch.
